arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fraud_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS distinct_users FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions labelled as fraud and the distinct users who made them, linking each transaction to its card's user.
assumptions: A transaction is labelled fraud when fraud_labels.is_fraud = 1; unlabelled transactions are excluded.
A user is the owner of the card used in the transaction (cards.user_id).
